brief:
Former U.S. President Donald Trump endorsed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of Israel's upcoming election, Al Jazeera English reported. The endorsement comes as Netanyahu campaigns for reelection and faces a competitive political contest.

National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, a far-right politician in Netanyahu's coalition, encountered student protesters during campaign activities. The demonstrations reflect ongoing tensions within Israeli society over security policies and coalition governance.
dek: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israel’s election, Ben-Gvir faces student protesters.
title: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israeli election
